name: 12-month sculpt plan
warmup: 5 min easy cardio, glute bridge ×15, banded side steps ×10 each way, bodyweight squat ×10, then 1-2 light sets of your first exercise.
terms: Right after your last set, cut the weight about 25% and do as many clean reps as you can.
After your last rep, hold the squeezed top position for 10 seconds.
Weeks 13, 26, 39 and 52: half the sets, about 20% lighter, plus one hard test set to estimate your max.
doneText: All 52 weeks are done. Compare your photos and measurements with Month 1, then start a new year from Phase 2 with heavier weights (Settings → Start the plan at week 14).

months.title: Foundation
months.goal: Phase 1 of 4: Learn the movements and build the habit. Main reps: 10-15. Effort: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank).
months.technique: 10-15 reps with light weights. Lower for 2-3 s and squeeze hard at the top. The glute bridge becomes a barbell hip thrust in week 5.
months.nutrition: Steps: 7,000-10,000 a day. Protein: about 1.6 g per kg of bodyweight, over 3-4 meals. To lean out, lose about 0.5% of bodyweight a week; to grow your glutes, eat at maintenance or slightly above. Sleep 7-9 hours.
months.base: Pick a weight that leaves the target RIR. Once you hit the top of the rep range on every set, add the smallest weight jump.

g1.name: Glute Bridge
g1.cue: Feet flat, drive through your heels and squeeze the glutes for 1 s at the top. Rest a dumbbell on your hips once 15 reps are easy.

g2.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
g2.cue: Hips back, flat back, soft knees. Lower until you feel the hamstrings stretch.

g3.name: Leg Press (feet high)
g3.cue: Higher feet put more work on the glutes. Lower until your hips are about to lift off the pad.

g4.name: Seated Hamstring Curl
g4.cue: Lean forward a little for a bigger stretch, control the way up.

g5.name: Hip Abduction Machine
g5.cue: Lean slightly forward and push the knees out with your glutes.

g6.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
g6.cue: Back against the pad, press up without arching, lower to ear level.

g7.name: Lat Pulldown
g7.cue: Pull your elbows down to your ribs, chest up.

g8.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
g8.cue: Bench at about 30°, elbows at 45°, lower slowly to the upper chest.

g9.name: Seated Cable Row
g9.cue: Sit tall, pull to your belly button, squeeze the shoulder blades.

g10.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
g10.cue: Wider shoulders make the waist look smaller. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

g11.name: Face Pull
g11.cue: For posture. Pull to your forehead, thumbs back.

g12.name: Biceps Curl
g12.cue: Elbows still, no swinging, 2-3 s on the way down.

g13.name: Triceps Pushdown
g13.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, full lockout.

g14.name: Plank
g14.cue: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze the glutes, ribs down.

g15.name: Goblet Squat
g15.cue: Chest up, sit between your heels.

g16.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
g16.cue: Step back, front shin close to vertical, push through the front heel.

g17.name: 45° Back Extension
g17.cue: Round the upper back slightly and squeeze the glutes to rise.

g18.name: Leg Extension
g18.cue: Squeeze 1 s at the top, lower slowly.

g19.name: Cable Glute Kickback
g19.cue: Lean forward a little, kick back and slightly out, squeeze at the top.

g20.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
g20.cue: Hand on the bench, pull the elbow toward your hip.

g21.name: Pallof Press
g21.cue: Side-on to the cable, press out and hold 2 s. Don't let it twist you.

g22.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
g22.cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, ribs down. Shins vertical at the top, squeeze 1 s.

g23.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
g23.cue: Bar close to your legs, hips back, flat back, soft knees. Lower until the hamstrings stretch.

g24.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
g24.cue: Back foot on a bench. Lean slightly forward for more glutes.

g25.name: Lying Hamstring Curl
g25.cue: Press your hips into the pad, 2-3 s on the way down.

g26.name: Assisted Pull-up or Lat Pulldown
g26.cue: Assisted machine or band, or the lat pulldown. Elbows down to your ribs.

g27.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
g27.cue: Chest on an incline bench, pull the elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades.

g28.name: Reverse Fly
g28.cue: Arms long, sweep wide, squeeze the rear delts.

g29.name: EZ-Bar Curl
g29.cue: Elbows still, no swinging, 2-3 s on the way down.

g30.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
g30.cue: Deep stretch behind the head, elbows pointing up.

g31.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
g31.cue: From the knees. Ribs down, glutes tight, roll out only as far as your lower back stays flat.

g32.name: Back Squat or Leg Press
g32.cue: Squat: brace, sit between your heels, knees over toes. Leg press: lower until your hips nearly lift off the pad.

g33.name: Walking Lunge
g33.cue: Long stride, back knee lightly touches the floor.

g34.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
g34.cue: Most of the weight on the front leg, back foot only for balance.

g35.name: Side Plank
g35.cue: Straight line from ear to ankle, hips high.

g36.name: Step-up
g36.cue: Knee-height box. Drive through the front heel, don't push off the back foot.

g37.name: Hamstring Curl
g37.cue: Seated or lying. Squeeze at the top, 2-3 s on the way down.

g38.name: Hip Abduction Machine
g38.cue: 1 s pause at the top. Lean slightly forward and push the knees out with your glutes.

g39.name: Overhead Press
g39.cue: Barbell or dumbbells. Squeeze glutes and abs, press straight up.

g40.name: Pull-up
g40.cue: Assisted or bodyweight. Dead hang to chin over the bar.

g41.name: Bench Press
g41.cue: Barbell or dumbbells. Shoulder blades squeezed, feet planted, lower to mid-chest.

g42.name: Barbell or Chest-Supported Row
g42.cue: Flat back, pull to the lower ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades.

g43.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
g43.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight, roll out only as far as your lower back stays flat.

g44.name: Back Squat
g44.cue: Brace hard, sit between your heels, knees over toes.

g45.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
g45.cue: Heavy dumbbells. Back foot on a bench. Lean slightly forward for more glutes.

g46.name: 45° Back Extension
g46.cue: Weighted: hold a plate or dumbbell. Round the upper back slightly and squeeze the glutes to rise.

g47.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
g47.cue: Close neutral handle, pull to the upper chest.

g48.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
g48.cue: Top hold on the last set. Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, ribs down. Shins vertical at the top, squeeze 1 s.

g49.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
g49.cue: Stand on a 5-10 cm step and step back for a deeper stretch.

g50.name: Hip Abduction Machine
g50.cue: Drop set on the last set. Lean slightly forward and push the knees out with your glutes.

g51.name: Arnold Press
g51.cue: Start with palms facing you, rotate them forward as you press up.

g52.name: Pull-up or Lat Pulldown
g52.cue: Pull-ups (assisted if needed) or the lat pulldown. Elbows down to your ribs.

g53.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
g53.cue: Drop set on the last set. Wider shoulders make the waist look smaller. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

g54.name: Cable Crunch
g54.cue: Round the spine and bring the ribs to the pelvis. Hips stay still.

g55.name: Back Squat or Hack Squat
g55.cue: Brace, control the way down, drive up through the whole foot.

g56.name: Leg Press (feet high and wide)
g56.cue: Feet high and wide on the platform for more glutes. Don't lock the knees at the top.

g57.name: Leg Extension
g57.cue: Drop set on the last set. Squeeze 1 s at the top, lower slowly.

g58.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
g58.cue: Hands wide, pull the elbows down and out, squeeze the lats.
